## Notes

Nine roles: player, NPC, player assistant, commentator/reteller, analyst, game master, game mechanic, automated designer, design assistant. LLM GMs accommodate bizarre requests; NPCs may hallucinate quests; design-tool latency 30 s to over a minute; commentary and retelling research limited.
